The few documented 99215 charts support the billed level, so the evidence is too thin to call either way.","leaning":"inconclusive","interpretation":"In every complexity tier, this provider's 99215 share runs roughly double the all-provider share, so case mix alone does not explain the excess. The sampled low-complexity 99215s include minor acute problems such as urinary infection (C0096163, C0096213), upper respiratory infection (C0096359) and a follow-up code (C0096433). Separately, the code mix leans heavily on 99214. Against that, all four documented 99215 claims (e.g., C0096525, C0097002) were supported at high MDM, and the 99214 mismatch rate is near peers. But four charts are far too few to judge, and the records cover only a small fraction of claims. The notes claiming moderate-plus data review with no lab or test line on the claim are only weak evidence of cloned or inflated notes. A reviewer should first request charts for the low-complexity 99215 claims listed, then a broader sample of 99214s, to see whether the documented MDM holds up where patient complexity is lowest."}
